pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

CFGOverride.name: CFGOverride
CFGOverride.description: Override cfg to a fixed value over a [start, end] percent (sigma) range. With multiple overrides, the one nearest the sampler wins on overlap.

CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

preset.tooltip: Named per-layer weight profile. Use 'custom' to supply your own via per_layer_weights.

per_layer_weights.tooltip: Comma-separated gains, one per conditioning tap (12 for Krea 2). Used only when preset = 'custom'.

multiplier.tooltip: Global gain applied after per-layer weighting. Keep ~1.0 with renormalize on for quality-preserving rebalance; values >1 amplify the whole tensor and can oversaturate.

renormalize.tooltip: Hold the input RMS after per-layer weighting so tap ratios change but overall magnitude does not. This is the quality-preserving mode and is on by default.

ConditioningKrea2Rebalance.name: ConditioningKrea2Rebalance
ConditioningKrea2Rebalance.description: Rebalance Krea 2's multi-layer text conditioning per tap, then apply a global gain.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

resolution.tooltip:
Resolution the model runs at (longest side, multiple of 14).
Lower = faster / less VRAM.
Higher = more detail.
Output is upsampled back to the original size.

resize_method.tooltip:
upper_bound_resize: scale so the longest side = resolution (caps memory, default).
lower_bound_resize: scale so the shortest side = resolution (preserves more detail on tall/wide images, uses more memory).

mode.tooltip:
mono: single view image (works with any model variant).
multiview: all images processed together for geometric consistency + camera pose (for Small/Base models only).

ref_view_strategy.tooltip:
Which view acts as the geometric anchor.
- saddle_balanced: the view most 'average' across all others (best general choice).
- saddle_sim_range: the view most visually distinct from the others.
- first / middle: fixed positional picks.

pose_method.tooltip:
How the camera field-of-view is estimated (for Small/Base models only).
- cam_dec: learned from image features.
- ray_pose: derived geometrically from the model's 3D ray output.
Affects perspective correctness of the 3D output. Try both if results look distorted.

output_tooltips:
Dictionary of non-normalized tensors.
Always has the keys: depth, image, mode.
Optional keys: sky (for Mono/Metric), confidence (for Small/Base), extrinsics + intrinsics (for multi-view).
DA3Inference.name: DA3Inference
DA3Inference.description: Run Depth Anything 3 on an image. In multi-view mode each image is treated as a separate view of the same scene.

output.tooltip:
- depth: normalised greyscale depth image.
- depth_colored: depth mapped through the Turbo colormap.
- sky_mask: sky probability in [0, 1] (for Mono/Metric models only).
- confidence: normalised depth confidence (for Small/Base models only).

normalization.tooltip:
- v2_style: mean/std normalisation for perceptually balanced results (default).
- min_max: stretches the full depth range to [0, 1] for maximum contrast.
- raw: no scaling,preserves metric units for Metric model.

apply_sky_clip.tooltip: Clip sky-region depth to the 99th percentile of foreground depth before normalisation. Requires a sky key in the da3_geometry input (for Mono/Metric models only).

normalization.tooltip:
- v2_style: mean/std normalisation for perceptually balanced results (default).
- min_max: stretches the full depth range to [0, 1] for maximum contrast.
- raw: no scaling,preserves metric units for Metric model.

apply_sky_clip.tooltip: Clip sky-region depth to the 99th percentile of foreground depth before normalisation. Requires a sky key in the da3_geometry input (for Mono/Metric models only).

colored.tooltip: Apply the Turbo colormap to the sky mask.
Apply the Turbo colormap to the confidence map.

DA3Render.name: DA3Render
DA3Render.description: Render a depth map, confidence map, or sky mask from Depth Anything 3 geometry data.

model.tooltip: Model used for the positive (conditional) pass.

model_negative.tooltip: Model used for the negative (unconditional) pass. Use the same model for ordinary CFG.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning run on the negative model. Leave unconnected for a text-free (image-only) unconditional pass.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

EmptyLatentImage.name: EmptyLatentImage
EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.

model.tooltip: If the `ImpactDummyInput` is connected to the model, the inference stage is skipped.

FaceDetailer.name: FaceDetailer
FaceDetailer.description:
This node enhances details by automatically detecting specific objects in the input image using detection models (bbox, segm, sam) and regenerating the image by enlarging the detected area based on the guide size.
Although this node is specialized to simplify the commonly used facial detail enhancement workflow, it can also be used for various automatic inpainting purposes depending on the detection model.

FluxKontextImageScale.name: FluxKontextImageScale
FluxKontextImageScale.description: This node resizes the image to one that is more optimal for flux kontext.

GetImageSize.name: GetImageSize
GetImageSize.description: Returns the width, height, and batch size of the image.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

preresize.tooltip: Resize the original image before processing.

mask_fill_holes.tooltip: Mark as masked any areas fully enclosed by mask.

mask_expand_pixels.tooltip: Expand the mask by a certain amount of pixels before processing.

mask_invert.tooltip: Invert mask so that anything masked will be kept.

mask_blend_pixels.tooltip: How many pixels to blend into the original image.

mask_hipass_filter.tooltip: Ignore mask values lower than this value.

context_from_mask_extend_factor.tooltip: Grow the context area from the mask by a certain factor in every direction. For example, 1.5 grabs extra 50% up, down, left, and right as context.

output_resize_to_target_size.tooltip: Force a specific resolution for sampling.

InpaintCropImproved.name: InpaintCropImproved
InpaintCropImproved.description: Crops an image around a mask for inpainting, the optional context mask defines an extra area to keep for the context.

InpaintStitchImproved.name: InpaintStitchImproved
InpaintStitchImproved.description: Stitches an image cropped with Inpaint Crop back into the original image

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

Krea2AnyPaintKnownLatent.name: Krea2AnyPaintKnownLatent
Krea2AnyPaintKnownLatent.description: VAE-encode the AnyPaint known image and attach the token-level noise mask (denoise 1.0).

Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch.name: Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch
Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch.description: AnyPaint reference conditioning: full-canvas registered ref RoPE + isolated reference attention via a per-run K/V cache. Chain conditioning from TextEncodeKrea2AnyPaint.

bbox_x1.tooltip: x1 = y1 = 0: source fills the canvas

mask.tooltip: White = generate. Source-sized (placed into the bbox) or canvas-sized.

Krea2AnyPaintPrepare.name: Krea2AnyPaintPrepare
Krea2AnyPaintPrepare.description: AnyPaint canvas prep: condition image, known image, keep mask (32 px redraw band) and generated mask.

strength.tooltip: Scales the adapter's LoRA only; img_in is never scaled.

color_end.tooltip: Zero the color map after this fraction of the steps.

depth_end.tooltip: Zero the depth map after this fraction of the steps.

color_image.tooltip: Flat-color region map at output size; black = unspecified.

depth_image.tooltip: Relative depth at output size, near = white.

Krea2DualControlApply.name: Krea2DualControlApply
Krea2DualControlApply.description: Krea 2 color-region + depth control adapter (darask0). Text-to-image graphs.

image_b.tooltip: 2nd reference (subject) for multi-ref LoRAs; vision blocks in training order: scene, subject

grounding_px.tooltip: cap longest side fed to Qwen3-VL; 0 = native

system_prompt.tooltip: advanced (optional): override the grounding system prompt (empty = training default). Steers what the vision encoder attends to, e.g. facial identity detail.

Krea2EditGroundedEncode.name: Krea2EditGroundedEncode
Krea2EditGroundedEncode.description: Encodes the edit instruction grounded on the source image (training-matched semantic path).

source_latent_b.tooltip: 2nd reference (subject photo) for multi-ref LoRAs -> RoPE frame=2, training-matched order: scene first, subject second

ref_boost.tooltip: reference-fidelity dial: multiplies target->reference attention. Applies to the LAST ref (= the subject in two-ref workflows, the only ref in single-ref). 1.0 = off, >1 pulls harder toward the reference's appearance, <1 loosens. Optimal value is model-specific

ref_boost_a.tooltip: same dial for the FIRST ref (= the scene in two-ref workflows). No effect in single-ref workflows. 1.0 = off

fit_mode.tooltip: how an image source fits a mismatched output aspect ratio (needs vae + source_image connected): fit = resample the source to the target grid at a centered offset — matches how this model was trained (default, use this); crop (legacy) = center-crop to the target AR then resize (v1/v1.1 geometry, only for older weights)

ref_boost_mask.tooltip: optional region on the (last) reference to boost, e.g. the face; empty = whole reference

vae.tooltip: RECOMMENDED with source_image: enables the blur-proof pixel-space path (crop+resize in pixels, encode internally) — immune to input/output resolution mismatches

source_image.tooltip: source as IMAGE (with vae connected): overrides source_latent with exact pixel-space fitting — fixes blurry results from mismatched resolutions

target_latent.tooltip: RECOMMENDED with vae + source_image: wire the SAME latent you feed KSampler.latent_image. Lets the node VAE-encode the source here, before sampling starts, instead of on the first step — otherwise the VAE is pulled onto the GPU mid-sampling and can evict part of the diffusion model, slowing every remaining step on VRAM-tight setups

ref_position.tooltip: where the LAST reference (the person in two-image workflows, or the only image) sits in position space. aligned (trained) = pinned onto the output layout, how the models were trained (default). beside = placed next to the canvas: identity still flows but the layout pin is gone, so the person can be restaged more freely. bag of features = experimental, content without layout

ref_position_a.tooltip: the same choice for the FIRST reference (the scene in two-image workflows); no effect with a single image. For putting a person into a scene: scene aligned + person beside

Krea2EditModelPatch.name: Krea2EditModelPatch
Krea2EditModelPatch.description: Adds the krea2_edit in-context source-preservation path (source latent as frame=1 tokens) to a Krea2 model.

kv_cache.tooltip: Cache the reference tokens' attention K/V: they are precomputed in one t=0 pass and reused every denoising step, so the refs never ride along in the per-step sequence. The LoRA must be trained with ai-toolkit's kv_cache model kwarg for this to work properly. Leave off for normal edit LoRAs.

Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch.name: Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch
Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch.description: Enable reference latents on a Krea 2 model (index_timestep_zero method, as trained by ai-toolkit). Chain conditioning from TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit or Set Reference Latent nodes. kv_cache enables the cached one-pass reference mode; the LoRA must be trained with ai-toolkit's kv_cache option for it to work properly.

Krea2OutpaintComposite.name: Krea2OutpaintComposite
Krea2OutpaintComposite.description: Multiband-blend the original source back into the outpainted canvas at its bbox (seamless).

Krea2OutpaintModelPatch.name: Krea2OutpaintModelPatch
Krea2OutpaintModelPatch.description: Enable bbox-placed reference conditioning for the krea2-outpaint LoRA. Chain conditioning from TextEncodeKrea2Outpaint.

stretch.tooltip: Stretch the sigmas to be in the range [terminal, 1].

terminal.tooltip: The terminal value of the sigmas after stretching.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

strength.tooltip: Scales the maps' contribution to the image tokens. 0.0 is the same as no maps, 1.0 is the trained strength.

start_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the control starts.

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the control ends. Ending early keeps the layout and depth while the rest of the steps loosen the shapes.

color_map.tooltip: One flat color per region, at the output size. The colors are only region IDs.

depth_map.tooltip: Depth map at the output size, near is white.

text_encoder.tooltip: bf16: a moss_image/<name>/text_encoder dir. fp8: qwen35_9b_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors (moss_image/fp8/ or text_encoders/).

ref_scale.tooltip: Ref side = target side / ref_scale. The colorize ref LoRA was trained at 2 (1/4 area).
